title: 信号发生器和示波器：第一条波形
summary: 信号发生器造出一个随时间变化的电压，示波器把它画成曲线。读懂屏幕上的格子，就能读出峰峰值、周期和偏置。
concepts: amplitude / Vpp 幅度 / 峰峰值
period / frequency 周期 / 频率
description: 信号发生器（正弦、1 kHz、幅度 1 V）接一个 100 kΩ 电阻和一个示波器探头：看懂屏幕上的格子，读出峰峰值、频率、周期、有效值和偏置。

cards.title: 先接上，看一条波
text: 这一课只用两台仪器：**信号发生器**造出一个会变的电压，**示波器**把它画出来。
按下面几步接好，然后改一下频率。
屏幕上的曲线怎么变了？横着的方向和竖着的方向，各代表什么？

cards.title: 屏幕是一张图：横轴时间，竖轴电压
text: - 示波器的屏幕是一张**电压—时间图**：曲线越高，那一刻电压越大；越往右，时间越晚。
- 格子是尺子。横着一格的时间叫**时间/格**，竖着一格的电压叫**伏/格**。
- 曲线重复一次用的时间叫**周期** T，每秒重复的次数叫**频率** f。两者互为倒数，比如刚才的 2 kHz：
![](fig:sine)
- 波峰离中线的距离叫**幅度**；波峰到波谷叫**峰峰值** Vpp，是幅度的两倍。

cards.title: 数格子，读读数
text: - 频率改回 **`1 kHz`**，把旋钮从「自动」改成固定的格子，自己数一数。
- 再给波形加一个**偏置**：整条曲线上下平移，形状不变。
- 正弦波还有一个常用的量叫**有效值**（rms）：幅度除以 √2。万用表交流档读到的就是它。

cards.title: 带走
text: - **示波器 = 电压随时间的图。** 横轴读时间，竖轴读电压，格子是尺子。
- **T = 1 / f**；峰峰值 = 2 × 幅度；正弦波的有效值 = 幅度 / √2。
- **真实的探头**有 ×1 和 ×10 两档。探头拨在 ×10、示波器还设成 ×1 时，读数会小 10 倍——先看一眼这两个开关。
- 下一课：给信号发生器接上一个电阻，波形会变小——它里面藏着一个电阻。

caption.text: 2 kHz、幅度 1 V 的正弦波：两条竖虚线之间是一个周期 T。数格子：一个周期占几格，再乘以时间/格。

i18n.en: A 2 kHz sine, 1 V amplitude: one period T lies between the two vertical dashed lines. Count how many squares it takes and multiply by time/div.

en.title: Function generator and scope: a first waveform
en.summary: The function generator makes a voltage that changes in time and the scope draws it. Read the grid and you can read peak-to-peak, period and offset.
en.description: A function generator (sine, 1 kHz, 1 V amplitude) driving a 100 kΩ resistor, with one scope probe on its output: learn the screen's grid and read peak-to-peak, frequency, period, rms and offset.
en.compare: **Compare**: 1 V amplitude → **2 V** peak-to-peak; 1 kHz → a **1 ms** period (exactly 10 squares at 100 µs/div); rms 1 / √2 ≈ **0.707 V**; with +1 V offset the average is **1 V**.
steps: Pick **Function generator**, click **`a5`** (red clip, signal), then **`tn5`** (black clip, COM). There is no other supply on the board, so its black clip is GND.
**Resistor**: **`b5`** and **`tn12`**, set to **`100 kΩ`** in Properties. It stands for the circuit the generator drives — a very light one that draws almost no current.
Pick **Scope probe**, click **`c5`** (tip), then **`tn8`** (ground clip, on GND). The probe goes to **CH1** and the scope window opens.
Click the generator and in Properties change the **frequency** from **`1 kHz`** to **`2 kHz`**. Watch the screen: does the height change, or the spacing?
Set the frequency back to **`1 kHz`**. Under the scope screen use − / + to set **time/div** to **`100 µs`** and **CH1 V/div** to **`1 V`**. Count: how many squares is one period? Peak to trough?
Click the generator and set the **offset** to **`+1 V`**: the whole wave moves up, its shape unchanged. By how many squares?
Set the offset back to **`0 V`**.
Press **Check my circuit** and read the numbers under the scope screen as each question says (for the last one, set the offset to `+1 V` first).
hints: Peak-to-peak = 2 × amplitude; period = 1 / frequency; a sine's rms = amplitude / √2.
Count squares: squares per period × time/div = period; squares from peak to trough × V/div = peak-to-peak.
The offset only shifts the whole wave up or down; the average equals the offset.
tests: The generator has an output: peak-to-peak about 2 × amplitude

measurements.ask: CH1 peak-to-peak Vpp (amplitude set to 1 V)
measurements.explain: Peak-to-peak = 2 × amplitude = 2 V. At 1 V/div, peak to trough is exactly 2 squares.

measurements.ask: The frequency shown under the screen
measurements.explain: The same as the generator's setting.

measurements.ask: Period T = 1 / f. Then count: at 100 µs/div, how many squares is one period?

measurements.explain: For a sine: rms = amplitude / √2 = 1 / 1.414 ≈ 0.707 V.
A sine is symmetric, its own average is 0; the offset lifts the whole wave, so the average equals the offset.

cards.title: Connect it and look at a wave
text: This lesson uses just two instruments: the **function generator** makes a voltage that keeps changing, the **oscilloscope** draws it.
Connect them in the steps below, then change the frequency.
How did the curve on the screen change? What do the across and up directions stand for?

cards.title: The screen is a graph: time across, voltage up
text: - The scope screen is a **voltage–time graph**: the higher the curve, the larger the voltage at that moment; further right is later.
- The grid is a ruler. The time of one square across is **time/div**; the voltage of one square up is **V/div**.
- The time the curve takes to repeat is the **period** T; the number of repeats per second is the **frequency** f. Each is one over the other — for the 2 kHz you just set:
![](fig:sine)
- The distance from the centre line to a peak is the **amplitude**; peak to trough is the **peak-to-peak** value Vpp, twice the amplitude.

cards.title: Count squares, read numbers
text: - Set the frequency back to **`1 kHz`**, turn the knobs from Auto to fixed squares and count for yourself.
- Then add an **offset**: the whole curve moves up or down, its shape unchanged.
- A sine wave has one more common number, the **rms value**: the amplitude divided by √2. A multimeter's AC range reads this one.

cards.title: Take away
text: - **A scope draws voltage against time.** Read time across, voltage up; the squares are the ruler.
- **T = 1 / f**; peak-to-peak = 2 × amplitude; a sine's rms value = amplitude / √2.
- **Real probes** have a ×1 and a ×10 setting. With the probe on ×10 and the scope still set to ×1, every reading is ten times too small — check both switches first.
- Next: put a resistor on the generator's output and the wave shrinks — there is a resistor hidden inside it.

tests.name: 信号发生器有输出：峰峰值约等于 2 × 幅度

compare: **对比**：幅度 1 V → 峰峰值 **2 V**；1 kHz → 周期 **1 ms**（100 µs/格 时正好 10 格）；有效值 1 / √2 ≈ **0.707 V**；偏置 +1 V 时平均值 **1 V**。

measurements.ask: CH1 的峰峰值 Vpp（幅度设为 1 V）
measurements.explain: 峰峰值 = 2 × 幅度 = 2 V。在 1 V/格 时，波峰到波谷正好 2 格。
和信号发生器的设定一样。

measurements.ask: 周期 T = 1 / f。再数一数：时间/格 100 µs 时，一个周期占几格？
CH1 的有效值 rms（同一状态）
把偏置调到 +1 V：CH1 的平均值
measurements.explain: 正弦波上下对称，自己的平均是 0；偏置把整条波形抬高，平均值就等于偏置。

steps.text: 选**「信号发生器」**，单击 **`a5`**（红夹子，信号），再单击 **`tn5`**（黑夹子，COM）。板上没有别的电源，它的黑夹子就是 GND。
**电阻**：**`b5`** 和 **`tn12`**，「属性」里设 **`100 kΩ`**。它代表信号发生器要驱动的电路——一个很“轻”的电路，几乎不取电流。
选**「示波器探头」**，单击 **`c5`**（针尖），再单击 **`tn8`**（接地夹，夹在 GND 上）。探头自动接 **CH1**，示波器窗口弹出来。
单击信号发生器，在「属性」里把**频率**从 **`1 kHz`** 改成 **`2 kHz`**。盯着屏幕：变的是波的高度，还是波的疏密？
把频率改回 **`1 kHz`**。在示波器窗口下面用 − / + 把**时间/格**调到 **`100 µs`**、**CH1 伏/格**调到 **`1 V`**。数一数：一个周期占几格？波峰到波谷占几格？
单击信号发生器，把**偏置**调到 **`+1 V`**：整条波形往上移，形状不变。它移了几格？
点**「检查我的电路」**，按测量题的说明读示波器屏幕下面的读数（最后一题要先把偏置调到 `+1 V`）。

hints: 峰峰值 = 2 × 幅度；周期 = 1 / 频率；正弦波的有效值 = 幅度 / √2。
数格子：一个周期占的格数 × 时间/格 = 周期；波峰到波谷的格数 × 伏/格 = 峰峰值。
偏置只把整条波形上下平移，平均值就等于偏置。
